title: Eventual zero in a filtered colimit of additive groups
statement: For a filtered diagram H of additive groups with colimit cocone t, if an element x at stage i maps to zero in the colimit, then there are j and a : i ⟶ j such that H.map a x = 0.

proof.text: Use the concrete filtered-colimit equality criterion with x and zero, then simplify the image of zero.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_filteredColimit_map_eq_zero
    {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I]
    (H : I ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (t : Cocone H) (ht : IsColimit t)
    (i : I) (x : H.obj i) (hx : (t.ι.app i).hom x = 0) :
    ∃ (j : I) (a : i ⟶ j), (H.map a).hom x = 0
